liste.soru: Is it really free? Will I be charged later?
liste.cevap: Yes, completely free. No feature is paid, PDF download included, and we never ask for your credit card. Donations cover our costs.
No. The editor and PDF download work without one. An account is only for saving to the cloud, keeping versions and continuing on another device.

liste.soru: What is an ATS, and is my resume compatible?
liste.cevap: An ATS is software companies use to screen applications. Our templates output real text, not images, so these systems read your resume correctly.
Without an account your resume stays in your browser only. With an account it is stored on our server, accessible only to you.
Common in Turkey and Germany, discouraged in the US and UK. Choose your target country and the editor suggests what fits.
